verses.literal: I am a rose of Sharon a lily of the valley
verses.literalPt: Eu sou um narciso de Sarom, Uma açucena dos vales.

verses.original: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַחוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖י בֵּ֥ין הַבָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·šō·wō·šan·nāh bên ha·ḥō·w·ḥîm kên ra‘·yā·ṯî bên hab·bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Like a lily among the thorns is my darling among the maidens
verses.literalPt: Qual uma açucena entre espinhos, Tal é a minha amada entre as mulheres.

verses.original: כְּתַפּ֙וּחַ֙ בַּעֲצֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖י בֵּ֣ין הַבָּנִ֑ים בְּצִלּוֹ֙ חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְיָשַׁ֔בְתִּי וּפִרְי֖וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯap·pū·aḥ ba·‘ă·ṣê hay·ya·‘ar kên dō·w·ḏî bên hab·bā·nîm bə·ṣil·lōw ḥim·maḏ·tî wə·yā·šaḇ·tî ū·p̄ir·yōw mā·ṯō·wq lə·ḥik·kî
verses.literal: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men I delight to sit in his shade and his fruit is sweet to my taste
verses.literalPt: Qual a macieira entre as árvores do bosque, Tal é o meu amado entre os homens. Sento-me com grande gozo à sua sombra, E o seu fruto é doce ao meu paladar.

verses.original: הֱבִיאַ֙נִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַיָּ֔יִן וְדִגְל֥וֹ עָלַ֖י אַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.literal: He has brought me to the house of wine and his banner over me is love
verses.literalPt: Leva-me ele à sala do banquete, E o seu estandarte sobre mim é o amor.

verses.original: סַמְּכ֙וּנִי֙ בָּֽאֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּי־ חוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: sam·mə·ḵū·nî bā·’ă·šî·šō·wṯ rap·pə·ḏū·nî bat·tap·pū·ḥîm kî- ḥō·w·laṯ ’a·hă·ḇāh ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Sustain me with raisins refresh me with apples for I am faint with love
verses.literalPt: Sustentai-me com passas, Confortai-me com maçãs, Pois desfaleço de amor.

verses.literal: His left hand is under my head and his right arm embraces me
verses.literalPt: A sua mão esquerda está debaixo da minha cabeça, E a sua direita me abraça.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם־ תָּעִ֧ירוּ׀ וְֽאִם־ תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־ הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiš·ba‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim biṣ·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ōw bə·’ay·lō·wṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’im- tā·‘î·rū wə·’im- tə·‘ō·wr·rū ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ‘aḏ šet·teḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: O daughters of Jerusalem I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right
verses.literalPt: Eu vos conjuro, filhas de Jerusalém, Pelas veadas e pelas gazelas do campo, Que não acordeis nem desperteis o amor, Até que queira.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔י הִנֵּה־ זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל־ הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל־ הַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl dō·w·ḏî hin·nêh- zeh bā mə·ḏal·lêḡ ‘al- he·hā·rîm mə·qap·pêṣ ‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Listen My beloved approaches Look Here he comes leaping across the mountains bounding over the hills
verses.literalPt: É a voz do meu amado! eis que ele vem, Saltando sobre os montes, pulando sobre os outeiros.

verses.original: דּוֹמֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ לִצְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה־ זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כָּתְלֵ֔נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֙יחַ֙ מִן־ הַֽחֲלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן־ הַֽחֲרַכִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dō·w·meh ḏō·w·ḏî liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm hin·nêh- zeh ‘ō·w·mêḏ ’a·ḥar kā·ṯə·lê·nū maš·gî·aḥ min- ha·ḥăl·lō·nō·wṯ mê·ṣîṣ min- ha·ḥă·rak·kîm
verses.literal: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag Look he stands behind our wall gazing through the windows peering through the lattice
verses.literalPt: O meu amado é como o veado ou filho da gazela: Eis que está por detrás da nossa parede, Olha pelas janelas, Lança os olhos pelas grades.

verses.original: עָנָ֥ה דוֹדִ֖י וְאָ֣מַר לִ֑י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nāh ḏō·w·ḏî wə·’ā·mar lî qū·mî lāḵ ra‘·yā·ṯî yā·p̄ā·ṯî ū·lə·ḵî- lāḵ
verses.literal: My beloved calls to me Arise my darling Come away with me my beautiful one
verses.literalPt: Falou o meu amado, e disse-me: Levanta-te, amada minha, formosa minha, e vem.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֥ה הַסְּתָו עָבָ֑ר הַגֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh has·sə·ṯå̄w ‘ā·ḇār hag·ge·šem ḥā·lap̄ hā·laḵ lōw
verses.literal: For now the winter is past the rain is over and gone
verses.literalPt: Pois, eis que já passou o inverno, Já se foi e cessou a chuva.

verses.original: הַנִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַזָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְק֥וֹל הַתּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·niṣ·ṣā·nîm nir·’ū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ‘êṯ haz·zā·mîr hig·gî·a‘ wə·qō·wl hat·tō·wr niš·ma‘ bə·’ar·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: The flowers have appeared in the countryside the season of singing has come and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land
verses.literalPt: As flores aparecem na terra: Já chegou o tempo de cantarem as aves, E a voz da rola ouve-se na nossa terra.

verses.original: הַתְּאֵנָה֙ חָֽנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔יהָ וְהַגְּפָנִ֥ים׀ סְמָדַ֖ר נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי לְכִי רַעְיָתִ֥י יָפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־ לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hat·tə·’ê·nāh ḥā·nə·ṭāh p̄ag·ge·hā wə·hag·gə·p̄ā·nîm sə·mā·ḏar nā·ṯə·nū rê·aḥ qū·mî lə·ḵī ra‘·yā·ṯî yā·p̄ā·ṯî ū·lə·ḵî- lāḵ
verses.literal: The fig tree ripens its figs the blossoming vines spread their fragrance Arise come away my darling come away with me my beautiful one
verses.literalPt: A figueira começa a dar os seus primeiros figos, E as vides estão em flor, Elas emitem a sua fragrância. Levanta-te, amada minha, formosa minha, e vem.

verses.original: יוֹנָתִ֞י בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֗לַע בְּסֵ֙תֶר֙ הַמַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֙ינִי֙ אֶתּ־ מַרְאַ֔יִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖ינִי אֶת־ קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·nā·ṯî bə·ḥaḡ·wê has·se·la‘ bə·sê·ṯer ham·maḏ·rê·ḡāh har·’î·nî ’eṯ- mar·ʾa·yiḵ haš·mî·‘î·nî ’eṯ- qō·w·lêḵ kî- qō·w·lêḵ ‘ā·rêḇ ū·mar·’êḵ nā·weh
verses.literal: O my dove in the clefts of the rock in the crevices of the cliff let me see your face let me hear your voice for your voice is sweet and your countenance is lovely
verses.literalPt: Pomba minha, que andas pelas fendas do penhasco, pelo esconderijo das ladeiras, Mostra-me o teu rosto, e faze-me ouvir a tua voz; Porque a tua voz é doce, e o teu rosto formoso.

verses.original: אֶֽחֱזוּ־ לָ֙נוּ֙ שֽׁוּעָלִ֔ים שֽׁוּעָלִ֥ים קְטַנִּ֖ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ סְמָדַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥĕ·zū- lā·nū šū·‘ā·lîm šū·‘ā·lîm qə·ṭan·nîm mə·ḥab·bə·lîm kə·rā·mîm ū·ḵə·rā·mê·nū sə·mā·ḏar
verses.literal: Catch for us the foxes the little foxes that ruin the vineyards for our vineyards are in bloom
verses.literalPt: Apanhai-nos as raposas, as pequenas raposas que fazem mal às vinhas; Pois as nossas vinhas estão em flor.

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥י לִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י ל֔וֹ הָרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏî lî wa·’ă·nî lōw hā·rō·‘eh baš·šō·wō·šan·nîm
verses.literal: My beloved is mine and I am his he pastures his flock among the lilies
verses.literalPt: O meu amado é meu, e eu sou dele; Ele apascenta o seu rebanho entre as açucenas.

verses.original: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֙וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵה־ לְךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜י לִצְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְעֹ֥פֶר הָאַיָּלִ֖ים עַל־ הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ še·yā·p̄ū·aḥ hay·yō·wm wə·nā·sū haṣ·ṣə·lā·lîm sōḇ də·mêh- lə·ḵā ḏō·w·ḏî liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm ‘al- hā·rê ḇā·ṯer
verses.literal: Before the day breaks and shadows flee turn my beloved and be like a gazelle or a young stag . . . on the mountains of Bether
verses.literalPt: Antes que refresque o dia e fujam as sombras, Volta, meu amado, e faze-te como o veado ou o filho da gazela, Sobre o monte de Beter.
